children: Conexeu Sciences Inc. reported third-quarter 2026 results showing no revenue and a wider net loss as the company scaled operations following its May 2026 Nasdaq listing. The company posted no revenue for the three months ended July 31, 2026 and recorded a net loss of $(7.73M), or $(0.29) per diluted share, compared with a net loss of $(1.30M), or $(0.09) per diluted share, in the year‑ago quarter.
Revenue was $0 for Q3 2026 (no revenue reported for the three months ended July 31, 2026 or 2025).
Net income: Net loss of $(7.73M) for Q3 2026 vs. net loss of $(1.30M) in the year‑ago quarter (△ $(6.43M) YoY).
Diluted EPS: Loss per share of $(0.29) for Q3 2026 vs. $(0.09) in the year‑ago quarter (widened loss YoY).
Public market transition: Completed a direct Nasdaq listing on May 21, 2026 and began trading as CNXU, prompting expanded public-company operations.
Operational scale-up: Rapid expansion of personnel, advisory and vendor engagements to support regulatory, commercial and market-awareness activities.
Product development & regulatory path: Advancing a biomaterial device with a planned FDA 510(k) submission targeted for Q1 2027.
Marketing & investor outreach: Launched a large investor relations and marketing campaign after listing, including prepaid multi‑month service agreements to build trading visibility.
R&D and lab infrastructure: Leased 24‑month lab space, increased R&D activities, engaged scientific consultants and procured development materials.
